task.title: Paging-batch residue: Err count clear, displaced_by unit test, e2e gate finally, inert-link feedback, seed-dependent assert
task.description:
Residue from the P6-130-133 paging batch adversarial review (2026-08-12), none blocking:

1. count_after_hydrate is never cleared on Err (catalog.rs ~:387-397): after a search error the mobile sheet button keeps the previous page phrase ("Show 23 results on this page") while the page shows an error.
2. displaced_by (catalog.rs ~:796) is the load-bearing P6-130 predicate but has no unit test (e2e-only); add a table-driven test.
3. e2e holdSearches gate (catalog.spec.ts ~:573-608, 683-700): if an assertion fails before release(), the still-installed route handler hangs the run to timeout — wrap release in finally or a fixture.
4. Inert PageLink gives keyboard users zero feedback (Enter silently no-ops; pointer-events-none also precludes cursor:not-allowed). Consider a tooltip/aria-live hint.
5. catalog.spec.ts ~:602 asserts /^\d+\+ results$/ for t:creature without verifying t:creature exceeds one page (only browse-all is verified) — will flake if the seed shrinks.
6. same_search is case-sensitive prefix-only (bolt→bolt2 retains, Bolt→bolt drops) — document in its doc comment.
7. "Show 50 results on this page" is awkward as a button label — wordsmith with the next UX pass.
